items.caption: A modern rendering of 說 in a seal-script style associated with its traditional dictionary analysis as 言 plus 兌.
items.alt: Black seal-style character 說, with 言 on the left and 兌 on the right.
items.selection_reason: The visible form illustrates the two parts named in the traditional analysis; it is useful for discussing that recorded analysis, though it does not establish the graph’s earliest form or origin.

limitations.text: This is a modern vector rendering in a seal-script style, not an image of an excavated artifact. The earliest attestation of 說 remains unresolved, and the drawing cannot establish when the graph arose.
